history.content: What are the oldest hardware products in the database?

The oldest hardware products in the database are:

When did the oldest one reach end of support?
The oldest hardware product, Cerebus, reached its End-of-Support (EOS) on August 19, 2007.

Cerebus had one support tier: Standard Support, which ended on August 19, 2007.
